mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ROLE FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIFE WHERE CREATED_AT + 9/24 >= TRUNC(SYSDATE + 9/24)) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GUEST_LIFE_STAT WHERE STARTED_AT + 9/24 >= TRUNC(SYSDATE + 9/24)) FROM dual
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LIFE) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GUEST_LIFE_STAT) FROM dual

SELECT START_TYPE AS startType, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'ENDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ended, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'ABANDONED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abandoned, SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'PLAYING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS playing, NVL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'ENDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS IN ('ENDED', 'ABANDONED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1), 0) AS endedRate, NVL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS = 'ABANDONED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN STATUS IN ('ENDED', 'ABANDONED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0), 1), 0) AS abandonedRate FROM ( SELECT START_TYPE, STATUS FROM LIFE UNION ALL SELECT 'GUEST', STATUS FROM GUEST_LIFE_STAT ) GROUP BY START_TYPE ORDER BY START_TYPE DESC

SELECT q.QUEST_ID AS questId, q.QUEST_NAME AS questName, COUNT(lq.ACHIEVED) AS picked, SUM(CASE WHEN lq.ACHIEVED = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS achieved, NVL(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN lq.ACHIEVED = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 / NULLIF(COUNT(lq.ACHIEVED), 0), 1), 0) AS rate FROM QUEST q LEFT JOIN LIFE_QUEST lq ON lq.QUEST_ID = q.QUEST_ID GROUP BY q.QUEST_ID, q.QUEST_NAME ORDER BY q.QUEST_ID

SELECT t.TRAIT_ID AS traitId, t.TRAIT_NAME AS traitName, NVL(ROUND(AVG(mt.TRAIT_LEVEL), 2), 0) AS avgLevel, SUM(CASE WHEN mt.TRAIT_LEVEL = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lv1, SUM(CASE WHEN mt.TRAIT_LEVEL = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lv2, SUM(CASE WHEN mt.TRAIT_LEVEL = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lv3, SUM(CASE WHEN mt.TRAIT_LEVEL = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lv4, SUM(CASE WHEN mt.TRAIT_LEVEL = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lv5 FROM TRAIT t LEFT JOIN MEMBER_TRAIT mt ON mt.TRAIT_ID = t.TRAIT_ID AND mt.MEMBER_ID IN (SELECT MEMBER_ID FROM MEMBER WHERE STATUS = 'ACTIVE') GROUP BY t.TRAIT_ID, t.TRAIT_NAME ORDER BY t.TRAIT_ID

SELECT c.COUNTRY_CODE AS countryCode, c.NAME_KO AS countryName, COUNT(x.DEATH_AGE) AS lives, NVL(ROUND(AVG(x.DEATH_AGE), 1), 0) AS avgDeathAge, ROUND(AVG(s.LIFE_EXPECTANCY), 1) AS realLifeExpectancy FROM COUNTRY c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT BIRTH_COUNTRY, BIRTH_YEAR, DEATH_AGE FROM LIFE WHERE STATUS = 'ENDED' AND DEATH_AGE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT BIRTH_COUNTRY, BIRTH_YEAR, DEATH_AGE FROM GUEST_LIFE_STAT WHERE STATUS = 'ENDED' AND DEATH_AGE IS NOT NULL ) x ON x.BIRTH_COUNTRY = c.COUNTRY_CODE LEFT JOIN COUNTRY_STAT s ON s.COUNTRY_CODE = x.BIRTH_COUNTRY AND s.DECADE = TRUNC(x.BIRTH_YEAR / 10) * 10 WHERE c.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' GROUP BY c.COUNTRY_CODE, c.NAME_KO ORDER BY lives DESC, c.COUNTRY_CODE

WITH days AS ( SELECT TRUNC(SYSDATE + 9/24) - LEVEL + 1 AS d FROM dual CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 14 ), lives AS ( SELECT TRUNC(CREATED_AT + 9/24) AS d, START_TYPE AS t, STATUS AS s FROM LIFE WHERE CREATED_AT + 9/24 >= TRUNC(SYSDATE + 9/24) - 13 UNION ALL SELECT TRUNC(STARTED_AT + 9/24), 'GUEST', STATUS FROM GUEST_LIFE_STAT WHERE STARTED_AT + 9/24 >= TRUNC(SYSDATE + 9/24) - 13 ) SELECT TO_CHAR(days.d, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lives l WHERE l.d = days.d AND l.t = 'MEMBER') AS memberStarts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lives l WHERE l.d = days.d AND l.t = 'GUEST') AS guestStarts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lives l WHERE l.d = days.d AND l.s = 'ENDED') AS ended, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lives l WHERE l.d = days.d AND l.s = 'ABANDONED') AS abandoned, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lives l WHERE l.d = days.d AND l.s NOT IN ('ENDED', 'ABANDONED')) AS playing FROM days ORDER BY days.d

SELECT NVL(DEATH_CAUSE, '기록 없음') AS cause, COUNT(*) AS lives, ROUND(AVG(DEATH_AGE), 1) AS avgAge FROM LIFE WHERE STATUS = 'ENDED' AND DEATH_AGE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY NVL(DEATH_CAUSE, '기록 없음') ORDER BY lives DESC

SELECT LEAST(FLOOR(DEATH_AGE / 10) * 10, 100) AS fromAge, COUNT(*) AS lives FROM ( SELECT DEATH_AGE FROM LIFE WHERE STATUS = 'ENDED' AND DEATH_AGE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT DEATH_AGE FROM GUEST_LIFE_STAT WHERE STATUS = 'ENDED' AND DEATH_AGE IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY LEAST(FLOOR(DEATH_AGE / 10) * 10, 100) ORDER BY fromAge

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT l.LIFE_ID AS lifeId, l.NAME AS name, l.BIRTH_COUNTRY AS countryCode, c.NAME_KO AS countryName, l.BIRTH_YEAR AS birthYear, l.DEATH_AGE AS deathAge, l.DEATH_CAUSE AS deathCause, l.START_TYPE AS startType, TO_CHAR(l.ENDED_AT + 9/24, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS endedAt FROM LIFE l LEFT JOIN COUNTRY c ON c.COUNTRY_CODE = l.BIRTH_COUNTRY WHERE l.STATUS = 'ENDED' AND l.ENDED_AT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY l.ENDED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{n}
